la.title: Los Angeles classification
la.intro: Choose the grade that describes the observed oesophageal mucosal breaks.
rows: One or more breaks 5 mm or shorter, without joining the tops of two mucosal folds.
At least one break longer than 5 mm, without joining the tops of two mucosal folds.
Breaks join the tops of two or more folds but involve less than 75% of the circumference.
Breaks involve at least 75% of the circumference.
la.source: ESGE STAR reporting standard, 2025 (Los Angeles classification).

prague.title: Prague C & M measurements
prague.intro: Measure in centimetres above the gastro-oesophageal junction, identified by the top of the gastric folds. These describe extent; they do not establish a histological diagnosis.
rows: Circumferential extent. Enter 0 if there is no circumferential segment.
Maximum extent, including tongues. M includes C; do not add C to M.
C = 2 cm and M = 4 cm are recorded as Prague C2M4.
Both values must be non-negative, with M at least as large as C. Leave an unmeasured value blank.
prague.source: International Working Group for the Classification of Oesophagitis: Prague C & M criteria.

forrest.title: Forrest ulcer stigmata
forrest.intro: Record the observed ulcer stigma. The classification does not select treatment or generate a risk alert.

sarin.title: Sarin gastric varices
sarin.intro: Choose the anatomical pattern. Record size, bleeding and any treatment separately.
rows: Oesophageal varices extending along the lesser curvature of the stomach.
Oesophageal varices extending into the gastric fundus.
Isolated gastric varices in the fundus.
Isolated gastric varices elsewhere in the stomach.

baveno.title: Oesophageal variceal size & red signs
baveno.intro: Document size and red signs separately. These observations do not calculate a bleeding-risk score.
rows: Record the observed red wale marks, cherry-red spots or haematocystic spots. Use Not assessed when the signs could not be assessed.
baveno.source: ESGE STAR reporting standard, 2025 (Baveno size categories and red signs).

erefs.title: EREFS components
erefs.intro: Record each endoscopic feature separately using the ESGE 2025 reporting definitions below. No total is calculated. Not assessed is different from 0 (absent).
rows: 0: absent. 1: reduced or absent vascular markings.
0: absent. 1: subtle circumferential ridges. 2: distinct rings that allow passage of a standard diagnostic endoscope. 3: rings that prevent its passage.
0: absent. 1: 10% or less of the oesophageal surface. 2: more than 10%.
0: absent. 1: present. This version uses a binary furrow component.
0: absent. 1: present. This does not establish an EoE diagnosis.
erefs.source: ESGE STAR reporting standard, 2025: EREFS component definitions (binary furrows).

paris.title: Paris superficial lesion morphology
paris.intro: Use when appropriate for a superficial lesion. Morphology alone does not establish malignancy, depth of invasion or a treatment plan. Keep the free description for other appearances.
rows: Record the dominant component first, for example 0-IIa + IIc or 0-IIc + IIa.
paris.source: Paris classification of superficial neoplastic lesions; ESGE STAR reporting standard, 2025.
